column1: # Files exempt from the --ratchet requirement (they may be touched without reducing their
# PMF/SPMF count). The ceiling still applies: a held file may not grow.
# A hold is a review action, not a way to silence CI. Each row needs a reason and should name
# what would let it be removed. Adding a row is a deliberate statement that this file is a
# compatibility or execution surface whose coupling is not yet reducible.

column2: Defines SPMF itself; retires when SPMF is replaced by a subprobability measure.
Executable exact-sampling representation; retires with the FinRatPMF.Raw measure denotation.
PMF-to-measure adapter; its whole purpose is the bridge, and it retires with PMF.
